title: Microduck - joint level (mj_host --brain)
description: The MuJoCo duck at the joints: the brain reads proprioception and publishes one ActionOut per policy joint (mj_host/src/OgmaBrainAdapter.cpp).

sources.name: joints
sources.description: 14 policy joint positions, normalised (kPolicyJoints order: left leg 5, neck/head 4, right leg 5)

sources.name: imu
sources.description: projected gravity [g_x g_y g_z] + gyro [w_x w_y w_z] — the two channels the real robot publishes

sources.name: lean
sources.description: signed fore/aft lean g_x, once per motor group (load_slots: 1)

sources.name: lean2
sources.description: pitch + roll per group, group-major [g0_pitch g0_roll g1_pitch g1_roll] (load_slots: 2)

sources.name: lean4
sources.description: pitch, roll and their rates ·0.3 per group, group-major (load_slots: 4)

sources.name: sense
sources.description: the full IMU vector twice, group-major, 12 slots per group (load_slots: 12): pitch g_x, roll g_y, pitch rate ·0.3, roll rate ·0.3, yaw rate ·0.3, accel x/20, accel y/20, accel z/20, head-frame pitch, head-frame roll, head-CoM Δx/0.1, head-CoM Δy/0.1

sources.name: sense1
sources.description: the same 12 slots once, for a body-level consumer such as the regime EPM: pitch g_x, roll g_y, pitch rate ·0.3, roll rate ·0.3, yaw rate ·0.3, accel x/20, accel y/20, accel z/20, head-frame pitch, head-frame roll, head-CoM Δx/0.1, head-CoM Δy/0.1
